mapper.select: SELECT social_account_id, member_id, provider, provider_user_id, email, created_at FROM social_account WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_user_id = #{providerUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO social_account( member_id, provider, provider_user_id, email, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{email}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO refresh_token( member_id, token, expires_at, revoked_yn, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{token}, #{expiresAt}, 'N', NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT refresh_token_id, member_id, token, expires_at, created_at FROM refresh_token WHERE token = #{token} AND revoked_yn = 'N' AND expires_at > NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked_yn = 'Y' WHERE token = #{token} AND revoked_yn = 'N'
